headlines.text: On this day in 2026, Claudio Castagnoli vs. Roderick Strong etched their names into history in the first-ever CMLL World Heavyweight Title match, appearing on Collision, rated 7.20 ? a well-paced, entertaining battle. Castagnoli ambushed Strong before the bell and spent the match dismantling his leg with a series of submissions, surviving several Boston Crab escape attempts before finishing him with the Neutralizer to retain the CMLL World Heavyweight Championship.
That Wednesday in 2024, Swerve Strickland vs. Jeff Hardy locked horns for the first time on Dynamite, rated 6.68.
Back on this day in 2026, Billy Gunn stepped back through the curtain after a long-awaited absence after just under 2 years away, appearing on Collision.
